WFT.ConfigHint: Set the token art, size and portrait for each form. Empty fields leave that property unchanged. Width/height/scale fall back to the world defaults (shown greyed out) when "Use world default sizes" is ticked.
WFT.CaptureHint: Copy the current token image, size, scale and portrait into this row
WFT.ConfigTarget: Unlinked token: this config is saved on the base actor "{name}" and shared by all of its unlinked tokens.
WFT.Defaults.Title: Default Form Sizes
WFT.Defaults.Hint: World-wide default token sizes per form, in grid units. Per-actor values override these. Leave a field empty to not change that property.
WFT.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable form token swapping
WFT.Settings.ChangePortrait.Name: Change portrait too
WFT.Settings.ChangePortrait.Hint: Also swap the actor portrait when a form has a portrait image set.
WFT.Settings.RollChangesForm.Name: Shape Change roll changes form
WFT.Settings.RollChangesForm.Hint: What happens when a Shape Change roll reaches the needed successes.
WFT.Settings.Announce.Name: Announce form changes from rolls
WFT.Settings.Announce.Hint: Post a chat message when a Shape Change roll changes the character's form.
WFT.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
WFT.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log what the module does to the browser console (F12).
WFT.Settings.DefaultsMenu.Name: Default form sizes
WFT.Settings.DefaultsMenu.Label: Configure
WFT.Settings.DefaultsMenu.Hint: Default token width/height/scale per form, overridden per actor.
WFT.Roll.ConfirmContent: {name} has enough successes. Shift into {form} now?
WFT.Roll.ConfirmPartial: {name} rolled {got} of {need} successes toward {target}. Shift partway into {form}?
WFT.Roll.AnnouncePartial: {name} shifts partway into {form} ({got} of {need} successes toward {target}).
WFT.Rage.Checkbox: Spend 1 Rage to shift instantly (no roll) — Rage: {rage}
WFT.Rage.NoTarget: Pick a form to shift into first.
WFT.Rage.NotEnough: Not enough Rage to shift instantly.
WFT.Rage.Announce: {name} spends 1 Rage and shifts instantly into {form} (Rage left: {rage}).
WFT.Settings.PartialShift.Name: Partial successes shift partway
WFT.Settings.PartialShift.Hint: Each success on a Shape Change roll moves one form toward the target (Homid, Glabro, Crinos, Hispo, Lupus). If off, successes add up across rolls until the full number is reached (the system's default).
WFT.Warn.NoGM: Form Tokens: some tokens could not be updated because you lack permission and no GM is connected.
WFT.Warn.ApplyFailed: Form Tokens: failed to update some tokens. See the console (F12) for details.
